description: Query terrain elevation in meters above sea level using the Open-Meteo 90m Copernicus DEM API (free for non-commercial use; commercial use requires a paid key or self-hosted ELEVATION_API_URL). Supports 4 modes: 'points' (discrete coordinates), 'grid' (N×N bbox sample statistics), 'line_of_sight' (3D terrain intervisibility with WGS84 Earth curvature & atmospheric refraction between two points), and 'profile' (cumulative elevation gain/loss and max grade % along a route_geometry or path).

bbox.description: A bounding box or point string to sample terrain elevation across (or SW-to-NE endpoints for 'line_of_sight'/'profile').

destination.description: End/target point ('lat,lng' or place name) for 'line_of_sight' or 'profile' mode.

grid_size.description: Grid dimension N (N x N samples, from 2 to 10) when sampling a bounding box. Defaults to 5 (25 sample points).

location.description: A text location to sample elevation across (e.g. 'Mount Rainier', 'Denver').

mode.description: Elevation query mode: 'points' (discrete coordinates), 'grid' (N×N bbox sample), 'line_of_sight' (3D terrain intervisibility & Earth curvature check between two points), or 'profile' (elevation gain/loss & grade profile along a path/route).

observer_height_meters.description: Observer height in meters above ground for 'line_of_sight' (default 1.7m).

origin.description: Start point ('lat,lng' or place name) for 'line_of_sight' or 'profile' mode.

points.description: List of {lat, lng, label?} points to query elevation for (up to 100 points). Also accepted as [observer, target] in 'line_of_sight' or path vertices in 'profile'.

refraction_coefficient.description: Atmospheric refraction coefficient k for Earth curvature in 'line_of_sight' (default 0.13).

route_geometry.description: GeoJSON LineString ({ type: 'LineString', coordinates: [[lng, lat], ...] }) from calculate_route to sample an elevation profile along.

sample_count.description: Number of elevation samples along the ray or route for 'line_of_sight' or 'profile' (5 to 100, default 25).

target_height_meters.description: Target height in meters above ground for 'line_of_sight' (default 0m).

name: get_elevation
